forward_api.blocker: PhysicalForwardFit.prediction() hardcodes a REAL Gaussian illumination amplitude at physical_forward_fit.py:186 (`amplitude = gaussian_amplitude(...)`) and never forms an imaginary illumination part; it cannot natively accept a complex pupil amplitude without a production edit.
forward_api.diagnostic_method: Wrapped model.propagate to multiply the complex pupil field by M=exp(s+i*t) BEFORE focal_intensity. Genuine pupil-plane complex amplitude; NOT an image-space correction. No production file edited.

method.optimizer: Adam, fixed a-priori; test scored once after fit
method.radiometry_at_score: gain/background/bias refit on B-TRAIN pixels only, then applied unchanged to train and test rows
method.origin_mode: session -- origin = B measured reference_start + original fit's fitted offset (origin_fit - measured_old), matching eval_transfer/results.json primary variant 'origin_session'
method.fast_radiometry_note: train-only g/b/c solved by batched torch least-squares with non-negative projection; matches production scipy NNLS to <0.01 counts on this dataset

baseline_frozen.description: Transferred Gaussian illumination with ORIGINAL fit's frozen radiometry; no fitting (matches eval_transfer/results.json).

gaussian_train_refit.description: Transferred Gaussian illumination; base physical params and radiometry refit on B-train only, no complex field.

fidelity_gate.note: Rebuilt forward from the refit's parameters + saved train-only radiometry after a full base restore; compares against the scored prediction to prove deterministic reproducibility.

summary.interpretation: No complex arm in this run; the delta compares the train-only Gaussian refit against the frozen baseline on the same origin mode.
